market_analysis.market_definition: The India Drone Surveying & LiDAR Mapping Market covers companies delivering the following. Products and technology: Drone type: rotary-wing, fixed-wing, hybrid VTOL, specialized UAV; sensor: LiDAR, photogrammetry, RGB, thermal, multispectral; positioning: GNSS/RTK, PPK, IMU; software: mission planning, point-cloud processing, 3D modeling, GIS/CAD deliverables. Services and business models: Hardware sale, drone-as-a-service, LiDAR-as-a-service, data-processing-as-a-service, turnkey survey project, managed survey program. Applications: Topographic mapping, corridor mapping, construction monitoring, volumetrics, mining survey, forestry, coastal/bathymetric survey, utility corridor mapping. End users: Surveying and geospatial firms, construction and infrastructure, mining, oil and gas, utilities, agriculture and forestry, government and public agencies. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
